appDescription: A driving diary app that records each drive from vehicle signals, tells the driver how their driving is changing on roads they repeat, and plays notes left at specific places on the route.

function.name: TAKE_IT_SLOW
function.description: Called when the driver says they want to take it slow or feels tense while driving. Remembers the current spot so the driver can review it after parking, and asks the navigation for a more comfortable route. It does not change the car's speed.

function.name: SAVE_NOTE_HERE
function.description: Saves a short spoken note at the car's current position so it is played at the same spot on the next drive to this destination.

note.description: The note to save, in the driver's own words.

function.name: ASK_MY_DRIVING
function.description: Answers the driver's question about their own driving, using vehicle signals recorded by this app: turn-signal use before turns, waiting time before lane changes, parking adjustments and braking. Covers the drive in progress, or the most recent drive when parked.

topic.description: What the driver asks about. One of: today, lane, turn, park, brake. Use today for a general question about the drive.
